lines: Ock. {place} bounced you? My cousin works that door. He says you know.
{place}, huh? Also Sal is not judging. Sal is a cat. Sal judges everyone.
Promoted! Mira, the pastrami's still the same price. Success doesn't change Sal's prices.
You've got the face of someone who signed something. Sandwich? Sandwiches don't get audited.
Heard you spent a few hours at the 114½. BEC on the house. Jail coffee is a crime.
Off the clock and still here? Babe, you need a hobby. Or a different café.
{coworker} is telling everyone about the idea you 'borrowed.' I'm not taking sides. I'm taking notes.
You got let go and you still come here? Iconic. Your old apron's in lost and found.
You. The list says no. I am the list.
Heard you did a few hours at the 114½. Respect. Still not getting in early.
Look at you, officially taken. Two drinks, one tab? Romance is dead. Long live splitting the bill.
Breakup drink's on the house. The second one isn't. The third one is a warning.
You and {coworker}? Pick a side of the bar. Not mine.
Back again? We started you a punch card. Ten visits, the eleventh is also jail.
You paid bail in cash. Bold. The coffee fund thanks you.
{place} filed a report on you. Three pages. Two just say 'rude.'
The jackpot kid! I never bought a ticket in my life. I'd like to start with yours.
Three winners? Lady Luck's either in love with you or running a very long con.
The winning manager walks in! I printed 4,000 stickers with your face. Please take some. Please.
Great win. Don't tell me how. Actually tell me. No, don't. Plausible deniability is my love language.
We lose, we regroup, we order pizza. That's politics, kid. Mostly the pizza part.
Your candidate's polling 'interestingly.' That's a real word in politics. It means bad.
Pivotly's badge reader still beeps red when you walk past. I didn't program that. I wish I had.
{coworker} made a slide about you. Slide 14. It has clip art and a timeline.
Promoted at Pivotly. Now you get to attend the meetings about the meetings. Congrats, I think.
Vivian asked me who started the rumor. I said 'the vents.' You owe me a muffin.
Big Screen's due at nine and Vivian has notes. Vivian always has notes. The notes have notes.
My favorite anonymous source! Kidding. Unless?
Banned from {place}? Babe, that's practically a press release.
Our new kingmaker. Remember who covered you first, babe. It was me. It's always me.
Official?! And I had to hear it from the group chat? I'll allow it. Once.
You're on the list. You're always on the list now. Funny how that works, right?
{place} called ahead. They said you'd try the rooftop next. Behave and you can stay.
A student! Half a bagel at student price. The other half, full price. That's an education.
I heard about the exam. The library has no answers. Only books. Which contain answers. Legitimately.
An A! I've reserved your carrel. The one with the good outlet. Don't tell the others.
Heatwave in November. Hydrate, or we'll be seeing each other professionally.
You and showtime again. They rehearse on my platform. I know every move now. Against my will.
The 114½ sends us its 'tired' cases. Sit. Drink water. Make better choices. In that order.
You party a lot for someone with a park-bench face. That's a compliment. From me it is.
Heartbreak is just love with nowhere to go. Light a candle. Two dollars. Sal's prices.
Business owner now? Then you know: the cart is never closed. It's just thinking.
Street fair weekend! Hot dogs are up a dollar. Don't look at me like that. It's tradition.
A winner buys a slice for the whole line. That's the law. I just made it, but it's the law.
Party supplies again? Aisle 4. The good chips are behind the bad chips. On purpose.
The power's out, so tonight's set is acoustic. Everything's acoustic if you believe.
